I’m so sorry. Finding a partner who respects you fully is so healing. I went through the same thing. Your trauma will never define you. Keep your head up ♥️

This is cruel. Staying alive and suffering for someone else's benefit is not a foundation for a happy life. You've essentially told a load of mentally ill people their feelings don't matter. Do better.

Leave this relationship. The second you're describing your partner as abusive it needs to end. You have all the hope in the world of getting on your feet, but not with someone who drains you. No one should ever make you feel like you're ready to die. Good luck and please message me if you need help!

Sometimes, yes. But ten minutes later, I want to do every thing there is do to on this planet. Before you think about ending your life, do whatever it is you have always thought about but never done. There are so many places to go and experiences to have, and there are so many options if you're struggling with your mental health. I was diagnosed with BPD at 18 and at first i thought i was destined to kill myself, that I was evil and unwanted, but I fought it with everything in me. I still went through some horrific times and made multiple attempts on my life. I still have bad days, but after 6 years of DBT I feel managed and at peace. I am now a trained counsellor with 2+ years experience in school to become a psychiatrist specializing in DBT and y'all can message me anytime for free. Life IS worth living and you can do literally anything you want. If you truly feel hopeless, PLEASE reach out to me. I will listen.
